task.title: Activate the current-dev PostgreSQL Lifecycle writer and reader
task.head_binding: The reviewer must bind this committed manifest to the exact final PR head in the canonical approve command.

not_changing: docker-compose.yml or deployment workflows (reserved for LIFECYCLE-PROJ-RETIRE-001 under SD-LIFE-03)
legacy JSON file deletion (reserved for LIFECYCLE-PROJ-RETIRE-001 under SD-LIFE-03)

contracts.relational_writer: LIFECYCLE_PROJECTOR_WRITER_BACKEND=postgres activates RelationalLifecycleProjector with ProjectionStore DML DSN, atomic batch transactions, contiguous checkpoints, and zero JSON generation or temp file writes.
contracts.relational_reader: PANTHEON_BFF_TRADE_JOURNEY_READER_BACKEND=postgres in BFF serves list, detail, stages, loop runs, attention, SLO metrics/incidents, and historical replay exclusively from PostgreSQL with zero JSON fallback.
contracts.readiness: BFF _lifecycle_projector_dependency reports authoritative postgres writer/reader status, controller scope, exact deployment SHA, and fails closed for backlog, quarantine, or stale poll.
contracts.backfill_watermark_invariant: _backfill derives and passes source_high_watermark from input records, ensuring checkpoint <= source_high_watermark invariant holds and backlog reaches 0 when complete.
contracts.fail_closed: Missing DSN when postgres backend is selected raises RuntimeError immediately rather than falling back silently.

validation.coverage: full trade_journey suite including relational projection store, incremental materializer, and lifecycle projector
BFF relational reader endpoints, postgres readiness dependencies, and trade journey contract validation
relational projector backend configuration, healthcheck, backfill watermark invariants, mode transitions, and zero JSON writes
compose and deploy contract alignment for operator-bff and loop-run-projector-scheduler

validation.command: python3 -m py_compile services/trade_journey/lifecycle_projector.py services/control-plane/bff/trade_journeys.py services/control-plane/bff/main.py && git diff --check origin/dev...HEAD

validation_environment.note: Auto-worker environments must run scripts/dev/provision_python_distribution.py before executing pytest suites.

required_checks: verify relational postgres writer activation in lifecycle_projector.py
verify relational postgres reader activation across all BFF read endpoints in trade_journeys.py with zero JSON fallback
verify BFF readiness check in main.py reflects postgres backend and fails closed on unready/stale/backlog conditions
verify _backfill derives and passes source_high_watermark from input and satisfies watermark invariant
verify tests pass using provisioned interpreter .venv-pantheon/bin/python3
bind this manifest path (docs/deployment/evidence/lifecycle-projector/PFG-LIFECYCLE-POSTGRES-ACTIVATION-20260824/evidence.json) to the exact final PR head in the governed approve command
